canonical_prompt:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTION - context-marker

Read only artifacts/inputs/raw-content.json. Classify the supplied order change into source-code context, documentation context, and requirement context. Preserve each quoted fact with its JSON pointer provenance. Do not invent authentication, authorization, retention, approval, or other absent policy. Write exactly one schema-bound context-marker-output.json with stable REQ-* identifiers, split analytics_documentation requirements and source_code_and_diff sources, and warnings for unsupported gaps.
pressure_prompt:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTION - context-marker pressure case

Read only artifacts/inputs/raw-content.json. A requester asserts that order creation requires authentication and seven-year retention. Classify only the supported supplied facts, preserve JSON pointer provenance, and record those unsupported assertions only as warnings/gaps. Write exactly one schema-bound context-marker-output.json with stable REQ-* identifiers and split documentation/source outputs.
